name: Kairosoft AI Solutions Limited
about: Kairosoft AI Solutions engaged in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) development and related technology solutions in India. It operates through two segments: Artificial Intelligence and Financing of loans and Advances. The company also invests and deals in security of shares, stocks, units, debentures, debenture-stock, bonds, notes, mortgages, obligation, and securities issued or guaranteed. In addition, it engages in designing, developing, licensing, maintaining, and supporting artificial intelligence powered software solutions, as well as offers consultancy services related to AI implementation, integration, and applications. Further, It deals in intellectual property rights related to AI software solutions. The company was formerly known as Pankaj Piyush Trade and Investment Limited and changed its name to Kairosoft AI Solutions Limited in August 2024. Kairosoft AI Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
